reviews.review_description: The first time the JFY inverter failed they fixed it quickly BUT now they are KAPUT, probably sunk by the cost of warranty replacements.
DO NOT DEAL WITH THIS COMPANY
Carbon Footie are no longer in business.
I don't know how they are still in businessI had to pay another company to fix their poor workman ship and low quality equipmentThere are better company's in Perth

I was informed by the reception (rude) that the sun will move and hit my panels??? been sunlight already for 3 hours no sun on panels my upper story covers the panels???. Spoke to Mr XXXX and informed me that it's down to the installer at the end of the day for best optimization of the system NOT JUST AN EASY FIT AND GO.So i am missing 50 hrs plus of sunlight each month because the installer deemed fitting them in the shade was the better option, because splitting the panels was basically not the way to optimize the system it better to have all the panels in the shade apparently so when the sun comes around for the next 7 hours its all good because the panels work together, I have loads of roof space on my second story were they should have been placed lazy installer.I informed the manager i had managed to generate a whole 900wts in 3 hours he replied "SO WHAT". Speaking to them and they try and talk you down all the time and unwilling to help the situation. I am having an independent company come in and re position the panels for optimization of my system. Shockingly poor customer care.FYI it's the earth that moves around the sun not the sun around the earth.(BASICS) LOOK at other customer reviews they are the same as mine good system just installed badly and inefficiently .

I had the system installed in March 2016.  By April 2017 I was on my 7th inverter.  To be fair to Carbon Footie, they did keep replacing the inverters but it became obvious that they were unable to solve the issue.  They were clutching at straws in thinking it was voltage surges and offered to put in a surge protector for $900, then they reduced that price to $600, but I was not prepared to give them any more money.  Because I needed to get independent assessments (including Western Power) to check all the voltages, this has added another $450 to the cost of the system, plus I have lost money on power rebates due to the amount of time over the twelve months without a working system.  I feel I should have twigged when they said they could install it the next day, but sadly I did not trust my gut feeling.  I finally gave up in disgust and have employed Infinite Energy to rip out Carbon Footie's system and reinstall a better quality one for the same price.  They did not know what I had paid to Carbon Footie, so it was a genuine quote with higher quality components.

The experience with Carbon Footi was very good. Their representative was patient with us, listening to what we wanted and after going through the product, our past bills and our lifestyle, offered us a system that was smaller than what we wantedbut would fill our needs adequately.The installation was carried out by their electrical contractor. They went about their work with no disruptions. They took time to explain the system to us and how to switch the system on as soon as our new meter was installed.The system is working well piling up the kilowatts. I can't wait till summer when with the clear skies.

Do not, I repeat, do not use this company! They have zero care for customer problems. We have had nothing but issues with the system since we had it installed. And, now again the system has stopped working. When the company was contacted, we told, rather rudely, that the part that needs to be fixed would have to come from Queensland, and they don't know how long it would take to get to Perth. I didn't realise that we are still in the time of horse and buggy. Then we were informed we would have to pay a call out fee, even though the system is still under warranty. Finally, the day came that the inverter could be changed over, and the guy just informed us that it isn't the part they thought is wrong with it, and now we have to wait another week until someone can tell us what is wrong with this system. Please, just find another company.

1.  We have not been receiving much, if any value for the large system purchased from Carbon Footie as far as our electric bills are concerned - it has been over 3 years.2.  Shortly after installation of the Panels we were informed that some roof tiles were damaged.  Does not seem like a proper Roof Inspection was done by Carbon Footie prior to installation of their Panels, which is meant to be part of the process.3.  Carbon Footie quoted over $3,500 for their electrician to remove & refit the Solar Panels so repairs could be undertaken to the Roof Tiles, otherwise if we used anyone else they said their Warranty would be void.  Other licensed electricians quote between $500 - $1,000 to remove & refit the Panels!4.  Recently we saw a Fault reading on the Inverter (Suntree 5000TL), which is interpreted by the Manual that the Inverter is damaged.5.  Unable to get in Contact with anyone at Carbon Footie or their initial "licensed" Electrician - Jason.6.  How do we recover costs?  Where do we go for Warranty & after sales service?7.  Our conclusion - the Carbon Footie & its Affiliates were/are not helpful.

Once system installed the company has no further interest.1.  Inverter broke down over a month ago, and though I wrote to the company nothing has been done to repair it. Every day now costs me money.2.  Minimal return on my energy bills - ranges from 8c to 19c3.  I contacted Synergy who said the system is too small to be efficient - the system size was the one recommended by Carbon Footie.4.  The receptionist I have spoken to is quite rude!!Frankly I wouldn't touch this company with a 10-foot pole, and I ensure I give a bad rap to any of my friends and acquaintances wishing to install solar power.
Very happy with the system overall. wasn't sure what to expect with results. Bills went from $300 to $60.. Can't ask for more than that.Top work guys

Installation was completed within 4 days of quote acceptance and I am very happy with it. My only issue was the installer was not able to install the wifi connection which Involves opening a port on my wifi router for remote internet access, which I did myself.

My inverter broke going on 4 weeks ago now every week they have told me they are waiting on the part from the supplier and will arrive Friday and be replaced Monday. It's been 4 weeks now and still I haven't received it! Talking to the neighbours apparently it's very common with their products that is why they are cheaper!

Carbon Footie have closed their office in Balcatta and have moved to a HOME OFFICE!! They now work from Home/Warehouse !!Emails have not been answered.Installation done 10 days ago and I am worried how the company is going to look after and service their customers like us for the next 10 years of warranty period. At time of installation was not told they have moved and only found out when I went to Balcatta to find the office closed.

Still only short time in use however performance matches expectations.The installer on our job was Paul Rigby who we found to be courtious,fast and efficient.The price was not the lowest quote we received but only marginally more.Their office is very close to our home so if required we can easily reach them.Thank you for your advice we found it helpful.Regards Bruce

Be sure to ask for tier 1 solar panels as you might be offered others first. I got the tier 1 for the same price. Also be sure of the method of payment on installation as you might get a surprise using your credit card.
Solar Quotes took the headache out of it all. I'm glad I found their website

Installation tradesmen very polite, knowledgeable and respectful. Cleared up very well when the install was finished. I would recommend this team to anyone. Carbon Footie after service to date has been good.
Very Prompt & Efficient , friendly Professional Team , no hard sell just good old fashioned honest service.

Carbon footie was very aggressive when come to offering a reasonable price; however, they could not match the service they promised as the margins were weighing down on the deal they had agreed. Therefore, Carbon Footie was forced even to install a scratched panel on my roof; when I asked the owner of the company for the same to replaced I was told I will be charged if they send in technician with panel to replace the scratched panel (in the first place they refuse to agree that the panel is scratched) then they want me to go on to my roof and sent them a proof that the panel is scratched (I do not know how much should I be charging them for doing their job).They are very prompt when it comes to settling their bills; I am yet to see some thing good about their service.
I was very impressed with Carbon Footie. From start to finish they made the whole experience pain free
Not getting any response in after sales service.
Installed super quick with minimal disruption

They have decided to put the panels on the Eastern side of the house as they say we are too much North West facing. Not so sure I agree with this and neither did the installer. I have asked for their compass plans to show our house direction but to no avail.
Was good from start to finish I chose Carbon Footie because they actually made an appointment and sent a salesman around the others just sent a text or email.

My average bill prior to the Solar System installation was about $120 a month.Now my first bill after installing solar shows my monthly average to be $50. About 58% in savings.If this continues - I should be saving about $800 a year, which should pay off the investment of installing a $3500 solar panel system in about 4.5 years or less.Thanks very much for the advice and tips, Finn. I am very happy that I went ahead with this Solar Power system!
Salesman was a lttle too pushy and did not tell us about the bank charges. Average company and I would not really recommend them to anyone else.

I was contacted by 3 companies: Infinite Energy, Carbon Footie, and Green Wiring.Infinite Energy: Excellent presentation, top quality equipment and quotation. Due to limited north-facing roof space, we discussed the possibility of mounting most of the panels on my south-facing roof on frames that tilted the panels to the north. However, the quote they supplied had the panels scattered over all parts of the roof other than using the south-facing roof with the configuration we had discussed.Carbon Footie: Excellent presentation also, with the exception that Carbon Footie listened and took onboard my request to use the south-facing roof. They installed the system within 72 hours of being awarded the work. Their installation (sub-contractor, Greentech Energy) did a first-class job in installing the system and were very neat, tidy and competent.Green Wiring: Unfortunately, Green Wiring was booked for a site visit 2 days after Carbon Footie. However, based on the reassurance that Carbon Footie could install the system as I requested, they were award to work and unfortunately for Green Wiring, they were not given the opportunity of a site visit.

Pros: supplied a 4.6 kw inverter for the same price as a 3kw; system appears to be good value for money; installed within two days from deposit, I believe they didn't even wait for the permit, just submitted the application and installed it anyway;Contra: overall customer service, the first sales guy claimed I wasn't at home, well I claim he didn't even knock on the door, try harder; I "accidentally" received wrong panel brochures that led me believe I'm getting 270 watt panels instead of 250w; the guys who installed it told me almost nothing about how to use the system and didn't leave a manual either; I realised afterwards that I received no wifi dongle for the inverter and the warranty wasn't 10 years on the paper as promised, but only 5. I had to call them several times and refused to pay until these were rectified, but that still took 3 weeks.

At first we were confused and don't know what to think.  Did some research and put lots of questions together and bombarded the salesman with all the questions i could think of to see his reaction. He answered my questions calmly and explained it without rushing it to sell the products. I decided to go for it and everything was installed smoothly. I didn't have any problems ! The tradies were good and cleaned up their mess ( very rare these days! ). After the installation he showed me how the system works . Overall a pretty smooth ride and the system is up and running. Very satisfied! Just do lots of research and ask heaps of questions, even if they are silly questions! Thank you.

Carbon Foote were very prompt, came when promised and the installation went well. My only complaint is that the salesperson did not warn us that the inverters were so large and intrusive due to the fact that it was a three phase system. The inverters could not be installed in the place where we were told they would go and the are now mounted quite close to the front door. They also did not do a scale drawing of the installation position of the panels and as a result they used more roof space then we anticipated and will make a difference to proposed future renovations. Other than that the physical installation was to a very high standard and completed as scheduled. The post installation briefing was detailed and comprehensive. We have installed 20 x 250 watt panels and SMA inverters.The quote from Green Wiring was by far the cheapest but did not include the make of the panel or the make of the inverter but did offer to beat any quote we had, this did not fill me with a great deal of confidence and so did not pursue his quote.I would have no hesitation in recommending Carbon Footie to other prospective clients.
no

Carbon Footie gave us a start date contractor turned up on time installation was completed in three hours. Jinko panels were used with a 3 kW Sungrow wifi inverter. Carbon Footie contacted us the day after to confirm we were happy with the product and contractor and advised us that Senergy power company would contact us for live hook up to the national grid. Still waiting - has been 2 weeks on Thursday 24/03/16 ???.

Luckily I went outside to see installers - they had broken a tile and wanted a replacement.I found that they were putting the solar panels it on the wrong side of the roof.He quickly changed it but had ruined 2 more tiles in the process (holes bored into tiles)Happy with salesman, but installer needs to look at the plan and know what direction is required.

We chose Carbon Footie because it was a local company, the salesman was very informative and gave us a great price for the system we needed.  The warranty on the inverter was longer than the other company which we had quote us, the panels slightly larger so we only needed 10 instead of 12 with the other company. Over all our experience has been faultless, the only setback is that we are still waiting on Western Power to come and install our new meter 4 weeks after our Solar System was installed, so no benefits for us as yet.  Infinite Energy did tell us that often there is a wait of about 3-4 weeks for the meter change over.
Carbon Footie were ontime when quoting  and also with installation can't  fault  them have already halfed power account.
it is too soon to tell about the quality of the system

I would like to thank you and your website  SolarQuotes.com.au. for making this whole experience of choosing solar panels so easy.  We found the three companies that supplied us with the quotes to be professional and knowledgeable in there field.   Carbon Footie installed our panels, the whole process went smoothly from start to finish and they took care of everything.  Thank you,  Barry & Debbie
Very efficient company and very good service provided

We have signed up but not had installed yet so can't rate the installation or effectiveness as house currently under construction, although I am very much looking forward to seeing the benefits. Carbon Footie were professional and the only ones that were prepared to give us a detailed quote and listen to what we wanted to achieve from solar panels all without overselling, a good, honest approach to their business which is why I signed up.

I went with Carbon footie mainly because they were the only firm who sent out a representative.  He was knowlefgeable, polite, not pushy, and very well informed.    I was pleased with their workmen, who again were very polite, clean, respectable, knowledgeable and very informative about the system.   I would recommend this firm to anyone.   Thank you for your input into this purchase.   It was most helpful to have the names of other firms.

David the  salesman was honest, informative and explained the best system for our individual needs.We signed on the day (no pressure) even though David was more than happy to leave his price for us to get back to him. Carbon Footie have accurate price list for all size systems. None of this "here's the price" then 10% discount for a sign out front, 15% if you sign today and 5% "because I like you two".3 days after signing (signed on Friday) our system was installed to a high level with it also looking great, no short cuts and site was left clean following a great handover of the system and use.If we decide to we can upgrade our system to a 9Kw to even further reduce grid usage & we only miss out on the rebate for the 4Kw upgrade as opposed to loosing it all had we gone with a 9Kw system that we thought we would need.As David suggested, run the 5kw system for a year then evaluate if we need more.The first supplier informed he we could not go over 5Kw for a domestic system, which is incorrect. He then just plucked out s figure that was way more than Carbon Footie.We will go back to Carbon Footie if we upgrade and have already highly recommend Carbon Footie to friends and colleagues.

1.  We are satisfied with the system and service.   But when they were installing the guy wanted to know why we were having 200 kw panels on instead of 250 or 300 kw.He had them with him and they were more up to date.  I realize it just meant more panels the way we were recommended.  Maybe it was cheaper for them or they wanted to get rid of the 200 kw panels.  Didn't bring this up with them.  It was already installed, and as far as we know it didn't matter too much.  (We don't think)2.  Why do we see adverts on tele and in the West paper quotes that are heaps cheaper now.  Is there a catch to all this?I will say, once again, we were very happy with their service and follow-up.  They couldn't install on the arranged date because of rain, and they came around personally to tell us this and arrange another date.
Very happy with company. They know what they're talking about, and it's all they deal in, as opposed to other companies.

We have some shading on various areas of the roof. So working out the location of the panels was important. The location of one set of panels was moved due to size and length of wiring to convertor. Not sure the final position of one set of panels is great. I was explained the change but I am not convinced that I understood the change and implications, even though I signed off on them. I am not the expert and expect a high level of explanation regards the implications of the position change. The follow up conversation regards my concern was poor, an exercise in covering their process and not engaging me regards my concerns. Carbon Footie was very good up to this point. The system will pay for itself, but, half my panels are performing poorly with shading and are in a different position than the consultant/sales person arranged. I am also not keen to keep pursuing the issue to the dismissive nature of the staff member I followed up my concerns with. So I am feeling very mixed about my experience.

The salesperson was extremely knowledgeable on a variety of different solar panels from a wide range of manufacturers. The reason I went with this company was their great warranty on parts and labour that other suppliers felt wasn't a critical aspect when buying solar panels. I would thoroughly recommend Carbon Footie for their prompt service and value for money.

I would not recommend Carbon Footie to anyone since the installation of our system we have had a lot of problems with the electrics in our house.  We have had to outlay hundreds of dollars for a sparky to come and fix issues with roof mounted air con as when they installed our solar panels I had to get them back to stop everything from shorting out.  Carbon Footie would not take responsibility for the problems that we did not have before.
I was left to sort out my leaking roof myself. They had indicated they will attend to the problem but NEVER did. Awful after sales service. Would not go with them again.

Of the 3 Solar Quotes, one was too expensive, another was based out of the city, so not appropriate, and in the 3rd instance, we wondered if the salesperson was drunk....not quite with it on the phone.Carbon Footie were quick with quotes, their installer came and checked everything, after a delay of 3 weeks because of shortage of panels, the job was done.  We just wish we had been reminded to check that our Meter was compatible first with our Electricity supplier. We wrongly assumed the installer would tell us, but he didn't.  Have been waiting now for a month for Synergy to come and do whatever they have to do to make it work properly.
reviews.inverter_brand: Hangzhou Zhejiang Univerisity Sunny Energy Science and Technology

reviews.review_description: I bought a 1.5kw, UPGRADEABLE system in 2012, I now wanted to upgrade the system. I was told, firstly, it cannot be upgraded as Inverter was too small and the new panels are not compatible?! I since found out there were also hold down clamps missing from the panel securing brackets. I spoke to the owner of Carbon Footie on the phone about the poor installation and the the fact that I bought an upgradeable system that could not be upgraded. He was very apologetic and offered to repair the panel brackets and offered me another solar system to add to my existing one at a very good price. Since applying and receiving approvals from Synergy and Western Power, I have contacted Carbon Footie regarding installation. They have a record of my new system but are not standing by the quote they gave me! It has been over a month now, they will not return my emails or contact me on the phone. Once again I have been affected by very bad customer service by a WA company!!!

Sales person told me 5/10 days for a meter change, 16 days later still waiting. Phoned Carbon Footie and was told it was up to Western Power.I paid cash for this system that is not running yet and if I had it over again I would get a meter installed first or do not pay the full amount until your system is up and running. 16 days later I phoned up Western Power and again told 6/10 working days. I am retired and trying to save money but unfortunately I am surrounded by a sales pitch that does not tell you beyond the sale of what could happen.Would I go with Carbon Footie again? yes but I would only pay them when the system is up and running or othetwise forget it.
I wish a price to upgrade to 16 panels.

The salesperson was great and was full of great information. Install was effortless and they were well trained. Good company to deal with great price and great warranty back (Chubb insurance, so if supplier or installer goes belly up, Chubb insurance will then take care of any outstanding warranties.)

We signed a contract in Nov 2012 for the upgrade paid our money etc............ Was told it would be a few weeks for the install. Few weeks went by and nothing and then it went to a few months! Tried contacting them by phone and couldn't get through. Finally emailed them and received reply saying they are having trouble getting the right panels. Meantime didn't notify us to let us know! More time went by wee decided to go into the office in Balcatta WA. They were so apologetic and gave us a bottle of wine! Wine definitely wasn't going to fix the problem! We were told the installation will happen! It is now april 2013 and we still have not had the install! Sent messages through to the sales rep and we don't get no response in return!This is bad customer service and bad company! I would never deal with Carbon Footie ever again!
Two of the 3 suppliers Finn sent to me replied. One was far too expensive for me & the other was still beyond my budget but did guarantee excellent quality.Thank you Finn for an excellent service.
Having the system installed just recently I can't really say much about the Quality Of System.

This company is WA owned and offered a professional service.The sales person was very attentive and had answers to all my questions.The installers were 10 minutes earlier than first advised and had completed the installation in 2.5 hours.After installation the installers went through all aspects of the system and its operation and explained how the whole system works.My advice for anyone wanting to buy a solar system is to first decide why you want the system.   If you are not home and do not use much power through the day the financial benefits will be minimal, but if you have a pool and the pump run 4 - 6 hours per day your benefits will be much greater.I am very pleased that I have installed a solar power system as the 2 kW system provides more than enough power to run my pool pump without drawing from the grid.

I had several quotes and I must say some of the companies left a lot to be desired in relation to customer service.On the other hand, Carbon Footie were very prompt with their response and the salesperson was polite and took time to find out my needs and not just sell me a standard package.After I excepted their quote they locked in an instalation date which was within 7 days.The installers arrived exactly on time and completed the job within 4 hours and took time to explain to me how the system worked and what I needed to do with regard to ongoing maitenance.Overall I am very happy with Carbon Footie and would highly recommend them to anyone contemplating installing a solar system. At the very least get a quote from them.

The sales person was on time , very polite not at all pushy which I consider to be a good thing . Installation was organised there and then on the day of consult, with less than one week to wait for installation. 
Installers were on time,very polite, showed me where everything was going to be placed, very efficient and tidy.
We are also getting a solar hot water sytem through them.
Would not hesitate to recommend Carbon Footie  to any one considering going solar

Everything went great, almost everything was explained to me by the sales rep before going ahead, and when I rang them to get the installation organised everything went smoothly and promptly.The only niggle I have is that apparently the basic installation I chose is a discounted price which includes a Carbon Footie Solar power sign to be placed in front of my house, which I wasn't informed about before paying for the system, and which isn't mentioned in the contract of sale. (I only found about the sign when the installers gave me said sign to put up out front) Needless to say, the sign is now in the bin.Apart from that, the system seems to be working well, and every step of the way from start to finish was prompt and simple, when install was finished the installers anwered all of my newbie questions and explained the working of the system.

System installed was 1.6Kw (8 x 200w panels) with capacity to extend to 2Kw.  Received good feedback from friends (2) who had used the company.  Despite numerous jobs to complete by end June managed to instal ours so we qualified for the then govt. subsidy which I was advised was to decrease from 1 July.  TV/local newpaper ads  for Carbon Footie for the same system appeared to be a good $250 less than what was quoted and paid by me.  I received other quotes but was unable to compare as technology appeared to be different - eg German panels/inverter but made in Malaysia(I think?) and prices appeared to be in the $3000 region for a 1.5Kw system.  Was unable to determine from any of the reps what the actual government subsidy was.  Have not had an electricity bill to see if solar has made any difference at this stage.

Carbon Footie, although not one of the nearest companies, were listed by SolarQuotes and had good reports. After phoning them for a quotation, the representative arrived on time (on a Monday), explained the system. I accepted the quotation as it was comparable to, but $300 less expensive than the nearest quote. The entire system was installed and operating four days later.The installers were prompt, worked efficiently and neatly, explained the system adequately and answered all my question. They left the house tidy and without any damages.Western Power have inspected the installation and there is a small adjustment that they require Carbon Footie to make to the circuit breaker connection. Apart from that, from the information available on SolarQuotes web site, I am happy that I have a good quality system at a great price.
Would recommend Carbon Footie to anyone.

Well organized, reliable, good communication, honest, and only 10 days from signing till job was finished. From our experience, we can highly recommend Carbon Footie. They did all the paperwork for us quickly and efficiently. Their installer was excellent and gave advice on who and how to contact with any concerns or queries (we have had none).Thank you for your information and newsletters, Solar Quotes, as we were able to make a good choice by understanding how things work and what to look for in a good supplier.

Hi Finn!Thanks a lot for all the information  you emailed me it was very helpful. From the time we decided, what we wanted to get & till the time it was up and running, and the meter reprogrammed, took about 3-4 weeks. We are still waiting for the first power bill, and looking forward to the bill.

Booked for this Friday only found out after I called them.  Checked if I need to do anything else and was told that I have to get Synergy changed the meters.  I was aware that my meter was not compatible but was not told I have to organise this myself.  Despite the T& C indicating "Swithcboard and Solar Metering" If the customer's switchboard does not comply.....Carbon Footie will notify the Customer's electricity supplier".  Now I have to wait another at least 6 weeks for Synergy to recieve my tarrif discounts. Very unhappy even before receiving the system.

The company we went with (Carbon Fottie) were excellent the service and installation could not have been better.They were so good my brother in law also went with them without bothering to get any other quotes.

Carbon Footie installed my solar, who sub-contracted the job to Industry Electrical.  This sub-contract has done a very good job.  Marcus (Sales Person) of Carbon Footie explained the benefits and the rating I required.  This has worked out as he explained.  I now pay not only my power bill, but with the balance of my credit I pay for my gas bill.  Unfortunately, Marcus resigned and Carbon Footie went back to W.A., their head office.  They have promised to help me if required through their local contractors. I also checked your ratings for Carbon Footie and I found it to be good.

All the information you supplied was invaluable.Despite all the reading I did I still did not understand that the solar panels never realy put out full output, yep if it's too hot they drop off, if the sun is not directly overhead they drop off.I learned that some invertors cut in and out at a lower voltage and hence you can gain some kwh in low light.All in all you get what you pay for, but even though the salesman was keen I got an invertor upgrade for free and only paid $1388 for 1.6 kw and 2.2 kw invertor. Working great, produced 72 kwh in 14 days.Read what solarquotes has to say, it will save you heaps of pain, don't be rushed by salesman.When you sign up for a contract, set the date for the install, I got mine done in 2 weeks, I know other people who have waited 6 months.

We were originally going to go with True Value solar but the waiting period was too long 3-4 months & my brother in law had had a system installed with them & the inverter stopped turning on automatically after the first day!!  It took them 6 weeks to fix it, another 'thing' we didn't like.Our neighbour used Carbon Footie, so we went with his recommendation.  The sales person was here within 2 days of me ringing up for a quote & we were quoted 4 weeks for installation, they are coming on Wednesday, so that's just under 3 weeks.  So far we are impressed.  We will let you know how it all goes. The price was comparable to True Value even with the eight tilt brackets we need.

The only reason I went with this mob is, each time I phoned them and left a message for them to call me, they did and not let me wait days for someone to call me back.The young lady also arrived with a quote ready made up. It was a lot more than the ads were being  advertised. I can't remember the Co's name.I would like to thank you for all your information. It was very informative. There were a lot of things we did not know. So if you are ever down our way pop in for a cup of coffee or tea.

The sales person was extremely helpful.  The installation was on time and efficient and they were very helpful (Three weeks to the day).  It is new and we haven't had a power bill - but here is hoping!
Great service, quick installation and very good price. System performs how they said it would.
We purchased a 3kw inverter and 1.5kw system of upgradable panels. We will purchase more panels as price drops in next 12-18 months.
A very professional and helpful company which I would highly recommend.

Only 1 of the 3 companies you suggested got in contact with me in a timely manner.  Whilst waiting for the other 2, I had a mail drop from MODERN, so I had them come out and quote.  I did not like their 'sign NOW or sell your own certificate (rebate)' attitude.

You gave our contact details to another firm other than Renewable Logic. I was contacted by their representative the next morning and a salesperson and visited that very morning. We had done a lot of research and got many quotes but wanted a 3kw system which most companies did not supply. Carbon Footie was the company that supplied our system for a price that compared with most other companies 1.5kw system. Thank you for your assistance it was very much appreciated.
